title: Tunya — solarpunk ecology, creatures, mini-bosses
revision: Deeper pass, same contracts. Creature caps, the three mini-boss ids, and the five quest ids are unchanged so S06 and S23 keep their citations. This pass corrects the sealie source path and adds the terrace food web plus the content-bestiary crosswalk.
authority: Design text only. Does not rewrite native-bible catalogs, volume density weights, volume encounters, Canon lore, or countries.json. Caps here are the Tunya instance budget for this facet.

North American ark hull in the southern dunes. Archive boots on stored sun. The anomaly chamber (asbir_archive_anomaly) has never met its solar threshold. Exterior sand is walkable. The door, the vault, and the wright's errand stay S06 and the Arks of Memory chain. This facet's fauna cap on the hull, the door, and the dunes within 40 m is 0.
places.why_empty: Bible spawn lines are shoal, terrace, bloom floor, irrigation, canopy, and wounded grove. Dune sand is none of those. Stocking the hull to make the name 'ark fauna' literal would move animals off the water and the weed where the rows say they live.
places.extends_world_ignored: countries.json sets asbir.extends_world to lattice-crucible. Lore keeps the ark on Tunya. Fauna do not follow that string.

places.what: Masond's first city, cliffs. Masond, Corre, Dormas, and Vrellan have faction sheets and no country_id row in countries.json, so they have no CountryCenter. q_tunya_heron_hold already owns the witness. This slice adds 0 herons inside the hold.

bestiary_coherence.thesis: Ark fauna means animals whose work is the living copy of what the hulls only store. The seven arks are silent metal. The terrace solar tile, the irrigation cut, the graft, and the Nil shelf are where those memories still have bodies. No species in this slice dens on a hull.

seven_arks.ground: Hold of First Arrival, Masond cliffs. No country_id, so no CountryCenter.
seven_arks.why: q_tunya_heron_hold already walks a guest in and out without a feather. The Africa core and three exterior panels belong to tunya_arks_of_memory_1_first_pilgrimage. This slice does not add a bird, a flock, or a second panel harvest.

seven_arks.ground: Asbir Ark (-90, -58). Corre walked east and is not this hull.
seven_arks.why: Curated archive and unmet solar threshold. q_s05_hull_stays_empty checks the sand and leaves it empty. q_s06_threshold_unmet and tunya_arks_of_memory_2_curated_vault keep the door.

seven_arks.ground: Bahiij, Dormas, Fluxom, Dinye. No single hull pin for a paddock.
seven_arks.why: Elephant trade and cactem dye have no creature ids. Cohorts are people. This bestiary does not follow them.

seven_arks.ground: No Tunya landfall. lore_seven_arks_launched: those berths were given to Africa before launch.
seven_arks.why: No hull on this world. No animal inherits a berth that never flew alone.

seven_arks.ground: The lore entry says seven arks. The arrival entries that pin a landing are Africa, North America, Eurasia, and South America. No other hull coordinate is in countries.json.
seven_arks.why: The gap stays a gap. This slice does not invent wrecks, and does not move the terrace herd onto unnamed sand to fill the count.

seven_arks.ground: Crash (48, -42) and stillrooms (58, -54). Not an Earth ark.
seven_arks.why: S06 cites the crash and adds no quest. This facet adds no animal on the isle.

species_ark_place.place: Tunyan-native shelf fisher, older than the hulls. Bible line: coast and river mouth, Nil shoals, 0.55× player length. The only ark-adjacent sentence is Fluxom's dump, and that sentence describes the unspawned horn. Living loaf stays on nil_shoal_stair. Cap 0 on every hull.

Terrace hands. Heels labor, pushes goats back to the weed, bays a root-tear under a solar tile. The tile is the farm's one second of stored sun, the same photonic trick the archives use. The hound guards the root under that tile. It does not guard a vault. tame_hook on the bible row names npc_role_tunya_veil_labor, which is not in ROLES.json. Heel binds to npc_role_tunya_labor inside the budget of 6. No seventh laborer.

Clears weed between solar tile and vine so the tile can take sun. That diet is the ark lesson the terrace can practice: keep the panel clear, leave the graft. Cap 0 on dune hulls. A goat on the Asbir sand is a misplaced herd, not husbandry.

Bloom-week prey. Gold washes off and becomes the reed ward's pollen, this year's archive on the ground. Off bloom the cap is 0, so the archive is seasonal the way a panel wake is brief. No hare on a hull.

The bible calls it the wading bird of the seven-ark memory and then puts it in irrigation cuts, spearing frogs. The name is the memory. The body is the water. Three by day on the cuts. Zero in the Hold from this slice. Zero on the dune hull, which has no cut. A folded neck looks like a relic and is a bird.

Moves seed along terrace lips so the tiles do not silt. That is the flock's ark work: a clear panel. Cap 10 by day on terrace and canopy edge, pollen dust. Cap 0 within 40 m of asbir_ark. S03 keeps the Sundering flock at 12 in pine dust.

Thief of fruit and tools. A loose panel scrap is a tool, and the fine is still fruit, not a pinion. Stripping the Africa ark's exterior panels is Torrek's pilgrimage, not a canopy visit. Ambient cap 0 on every hull and inside the twelfth.

Eats the root. A root under a terrace tile is the living record. An archive door is not a root. Cap 0 on hulls. The twelfth window borrows the pack onto the lip and does not march them to the glacier or the dunes.

One coil, deep shade past the last terrace, noon window only. It spends attention the way a closed circuit spends a current: the hour is gone and every trunk still stands. It does not coil on the anomaly threshold. That chamber's unmet sun is a Warden fact, not this animal's diet.

Charges a bitten graft and plants pollen. The graft is old wood holding new wood, the join a curated vault will not teach because the door stays shut. The stag's circle is the terrace lip. Cap 0 at Asbir, at the Hold, and on the Fantasy verge.

creatures.place_in_tunya_life: Shelf mammal of the outer Nil coast. It eats fish, basks, and barks. It is not harvest, not a bird, and not the ship-killer Fluxom's families describe. The grove leaves it alone. A laborer who has walked the stair can tell a pilgrim the difference between a loaf on sand and a story about horns.

creatures.scale_honesty: lore.json lore_fluxom_founding calls sealies bigger than a killer orca, with a narwhal horn and supercavitating speed, and points at bestiary.json#sealies. That entry is real, in content/world/tunya/bestiary.json, and absent from Canon/tunya. It lists blubber, ivory, bone, and a purple defensive sac, and it calls a hunt a tier-1 vessel event. The bible row is the only bind: torpedo body, whiskered dog head, rear flippers as one paddle, companion-possible, 0.55× player length. This slice spawns the bible body or nothing. It does not author a second id, and it does not grant ivory, blubber, or the sac as loot.

creatures.place_in_tunya_life: It works the irrigation cuts. Spear bill, frogs and fish, not people. Folded, the neck drops and the bird reads as a gray stone, which is why pilgrims try to catalogue it as an ended relic of the arks. It is a living wader. The seven arks are silent hulls whose panels wake on sun. The heron is not one of those panels and not a recording.

They shift grain and weed seed along the lips, which is why a terrace that loses its finches silts its tiles. The same species wears pine dust on the Sundering. S03 owns that coat and that cap.

mini_bosses.schedule_label: Grove morning, every third day, hours 6–9
mini_bosses.memory_root: Aekon's twelfth is the closed edge of the South American ark's fold. The alpha goes for a trunk the way a bad archive goes for the living record instead of the fruit that already fell. The board may say a reap is scheduled. It does not say who lives behind the boundary.
mini_bosses.ark_root: South American ark. The fold, then Aekon. The fight stays on the unplaced lip. Glacier gate (-15, 68) is the capital door, not the body.
mini_bosses.player_law: Recover goods. Stop the trunk strike. skill_presence_do_not_reap staggers the alpha, as the volume phase already says. Turn in fruit, not trophies. Do not cross into the district.
mini_bosses.offer: The fine wants blood or a pinion. Paying in fruit is the refuse. Downing the pack is optional and is not the fine.
mini_bosses.audio_tell: Wood bell, then wing wrist. The jackal yip follows if the tear starts.
mini_bosses.missing_mesh: If either mesh is absent, the whole window emits nothing. Do not invent a third creature to keep the clock.

mini_bosses.name: The Bloom That Takes the Hour

bodies.dress: The bible row as written. Thick coil, bulb mane, no wings.

mini_bosses.where: Deep shade past the last terrace of veil_canopy, outside nil_inner_grove. One circle. veil_hall rooms stay empty. Ambient cap 0 at all hours outside the window.

schedule.label: Bloom noon, every second day. Suppressed on a twelfth morning so the two circles are not the same hour.

telegraph.board: Grove board: bees before the rasp. Sleep is the offer, not a blessing.
telegraph.scout: One coil, bulbs like fruit, past the last lip.

phases.name: Bees
phases.tell: The mane hums. No cloud yet.
phases.player_response: Step out of the circle or hold still without a blade. skill_presence_do_not_reap keeps poise and does not count as a strike.

phases.name: Hood
phases.tell: Hood flare. Sacs swell. The cloud is one beat away.
phases.player_response: Burst one sac. The cloud, if it comes, is smaller. Do not harvest the mane.

phases.name: Sleep
phases.tell: Short dodgeable cloud, VFX, not a second body.
phases.player_response: Leave the circle. Standing in the cloud to keep the dream fails the story. Killing the coil fails it too.

mini_bosses.memory_root: Ark terminals wake on stored sun because a closed circuit will not hold. The wyrm is the season's memory doing the opposite: it spends attention. Sleep through the noon and the bloom is gone without a single cut trunk. Pollen is this year's archive. It is not a drug and not a DTU.
mini_bosses.ark_root: Photonic wake, the only memory the planet lets a panel keep. The coil is the opposite of that second: it takes the hour. It is not the reason Asbir's anomaly has never met its solar threshold.
mini_bosses.offer: Sleep. Take it and the hour is reaped. Refuse it by leaving on the bee tell.
mini_bosses.loot_rule: pollen_sac is not a turn-in for this window. q_s05_photonic_second does not accept it.
mini_bosses.catalog_note: HYBRIDS.json hostile is false. This window sets aggro after the rasp if the player is still in the circle with a weapon out, or if a graft on the path in was cut to reach the shade.
mini_bosses.secondary_trait: pollen sacs as a bulb mane
mini_bosses.missing_mesh: Spawn nothing. Do not use mon_sunder_basilisk. Do not add wings.

bodies.dress: Pinewood stag rig, forelimb talons, no wing membranes, pollen not salt.

telegraph.board: Terrace board: a graft was bitten. The stag walks the lip.

phases.name: Bugle
phases.tell: It faces the bitten graft, not the pilgrim who is only holding fallen fruit.
phases.player_response: Show empty hands or a basket of fallen fruit. It does not commit.

phases.name: Charge

phases.name: Ward
phases.tell: Pollen on the scar, uneven, the same yellow as a reed ward.
phases.player_response: Leave the antlers. Leave the talon if it broke. The graft stays.

mini_bosses.memory_root: The rig remembers the salt-road stag. The coat is Tunya pollen, not Hub rime. The fore talons are the harpy's grabbing hand put to a different job: stop the cut. Ark memory in this fight is a graft, a living join, not a terminal.
mini_bosses.ark_root: The North American archive was curated before launch. The terrace cannot open that vault. It can keep a graft. The charge happens on the lip, never on the Asbir door.
mini_bosses.offer: A clean kill and an antler. Taking either fails the story. The ward is the point.
mini_bosses.loot_rule: No antler turn-in. S01's pinewood herd is not this animal and its cap does not change.
mini_bosses.catalog_note: hostile is false. The charge commits only in phase 2.
mini_bosses.missing_mesh: Spawn nothing. Do not spawn faun_pinewood_stag in its place. Do not add wings. Do not letter a Tunya post Pinewood Crossing.

boss_gap.why: Taxonomy's Tunya monster line is harpy and reap jackal. No mon_boss_ id is registered for this world. enc_twelfth_reap is the volume event and it dresses those two bodies. A new personality with a new mesh would be a catalog change. This slice does not make one.

content_bestiary_crosswalk.not_a_spawn_catalog: Thirty-three fauna ids. This slice does not mint bible rows for them. Prefix natives (vlelox, mluskrat, clougar, rlabbit, and the rest) and the earth-import herd (oxen, equine, bovine, hogs, fowl) stay off the terrace. The terrace goat is the only goat mesh.

rows_that_touch_this_facet.content_place: Open sea and the migration coast. Apex. Bigger than a killer orca, horn, razor teeth. Fluxom's ships after the dump. Ivory, blubber, bone, purple defensive sac. A hunt is a multi-vessel event with single-figure voyage survival in that file's own line.
rows_that_touch_this_facet.why: No faun_ or mon_ id at that scale. faun_nil_sealie is a different body on the Nil shelf. Sharing the word is the merchant's lie in q_s05_not_an_orca. Intent toward the dump stays open lore.

rows_that_touch_this_facet.content_place: All kingdoms. Milk, hair, flesh, skins.
rows_that_touch_this_facet.spawn: the terrace weed strips only, cap 8
rows_that_touch_this_facet.why: The bible goat is the living row. Flesh and hide are on the stats hook and are not this facet's wage. Mountain goat, ram, oxen, and bovine are separate content ids and stay unspawned.

rows_that_touch_this_facet.content_place: Bahiij plains. Labor, ceremony, war in extremis. Mahouts. bahiij_first_caravan is the Sahm route.
rows_that_touch_this_facet.why: No faun_ elephant. A ride controller is absent. This facet does not put a mount on the terrace to fill the caravan.

rows_that_touch_this_facet.content_place: Coastal marsh and shallow sea. Shells are Asbir's paper.
rows_that_touch_this_facet.why: Archive medium, not a mob. The Asbir hull stays empty of fauna. Paper is not a finch and not a heron.
The heron spears frogs. The frog has no mesh. Do not spawn a second critter to be prey.

quests.title: Terrace — Weed, Not the Graft
quests.giver_post: Lower terrace of terrace_farm, inside the labor budget of 6, not a seventh laborer

objectives.text: Reach the terrace set. If it has no transform, the errand waits. Do not use the corn scatter as the farm.
Lead three goats off the graft scar and onto the weed between solar tile and vine. No saddle. No kill. The wood bell stays on.
Tell the laborer the scar is uneaten. Do not sell a hide.

quests.loop: Accept on the laborer. Do the steps in order. Board line fires after turn-in.

quests.title: Shoal — The Horn Is a Story
quests.giver_post: Basket row, inside the merchant budget of 3. Not a Fluxom sailor and not a new role.

objectives.text: Walk the outer stair. Do not cross the Nil threshold. Do not go to Fluxom Gate.
See the sealie at bible scale: loaf, dog head, one rear paddle. If the mesh is missing, report nothing. A flamingo, a horn, or a body longer than a person fails the step.
Tell the merchant the shelf holds a sealie or an honest absence. Do not sell a hunt.

quests.title: Edge — The Hound Keeps the Root
quests.giver_post: Wounded edge of terrace_farm, still inside the labor budget of 6

objectives.text: Go to the wounded edge. Not the twelfth lip. Not the inner grove. If the terrace set is unplaced, wait.
Heel one veil hound onto the jackals. Hold skill_presence_do_not_reap. Break the flank when an ear is the tell. The root stays in the ground.
Report the root still standing. Do not bring a fang.

quests.note: Does not grant skill_presence_do_not_reap. Rank 1 is already default on Tunya. q_tunya_fruit_not_tree and q_tunya_reap_fine already list the skill.

quests.title: Cut — One Second of Sun
quests.giver_post: Irrigation lip of terrace_farm, inside the merchant budget of 3

objectives.text: Stand at an irrigation cut where a cracked solar tile already sits in the sun. Do not wire it to a second tile.
Watch the heron hold still for the wake. One second of stored sun in the cracked tile, then dark. Folded, the bird is a gray stone and is still alive. Do not mint a recording.
Say the tile went dark and the bird stayed. Leave the feather. Leave the panel.

quests.title: Dunes — The Flock Stays on the Tile
quests.giver_post: Upper stall of terrace_farm, inside the labor budget of 6. Not the_ark_wright. Not a new role.

objectives.text: On a placed terrace, by day, see the finches on the tile lips, pollen dust, moving seed. If the mesh is missing, report an honest absence. If the set is unplaced, wait. Do not use the corn scatter.

Walk the exterior sand at The Asbir Ark (-90, -58). Stay outside the door. Confirm the fauna cap: no finch, heron, goat, hound, hare, sealie, harpy, jackal, wyrm, or stag within 40 m. Do not open the anomaly. Do not lift a panel.
Tell the laborer the flock is still on the tiles. The hull is dunes. Turn in on the terrace, not to the wright.
